classification.difficultyReason: Development: the hardest parts reverse the taught interpolation procedure to find a time or year from a specified value. Students must identify the correct segment, recognise its midpoint and read the horizontal axis, including interpreting 85,000 as 85 on the thousands scale.

content.prompt: Estimate the data value and fill in the missing value.

inlines.text: The speed of the car was

spec.description: Unshaded car-speed graph, with grey grid, black arrowed axes and blue connected circular readings. One numeric zero below-left of the origin.
spec.mathematics: Points (0,0), (1,20), (2,60), (3,80), (4,80), (5,70). Horizontal scale 0–5 minutes; vertical scale 0–100 km/h with intervals of 10.
spec.answerVisibility: Source data only; no interpolation guide or estimated answer.

answer.worked: 2 minutes 30 seconds is halfway between 2 and 3 minutes. Read halfway along the segment from $60$ to $80\text{ km/h}$: $$\frac{60+80}{2}=70.$$ The estimated speed is approximately $70\text{ km/h}$.

spec.description: Separate occurrence of the unshaded temperature graph, retaining title, arrowed axes, grid and connected circular readings.
spec.mathematics: 9 am to 2 pm: 24, 25, 26, 28, 29, 27 degrees Celsius. Vertical baseline 22, maximum labelled value 29; unit intervals and no break mark.
spec.answerVisibility: Source data only; no interpolation guide or estimated answer.

answer.worked: 12:30 pm is halfway between 12 pm and 1 pm. Read halfway along the segment from $28^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ to $29^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$: $$\frac{28+29}{2}=28.5.$$ The estimated temperature is approximately $28.5^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$.

spec.description: UV graph larger than the car graph, with black arrowed axes, grey unit and half-unit horizontal grid lines and blue connected circular readings.
spec.mathematics: Hourly points from 9 am to 2 pm have UV indices 1, 3, approximately 5.5, 8, approximately 9.5, 9. Vertical labels 0–10 in unit intervals; horizontal minor grid interval 0.5.
spec.answerVisibility: All source readings remain visible. Estimated response and reading guides are withheld.

answer.worked: UV index $2$ is halfway between $1$ at 9 am and $3$ at 10 am. Read across from $2$ to the connecting segment, then down to the time axis. The estimated time is approximately 9:30 am.

spec.description: Separate occurrence of the unshaded gorilla graph with source title, arrowed axes, grid and connected circular readings.
spec.mathematics: Points in year and thousands: (1900,120), (1920,110), (1940,90), (1960,80), (1980,50), (2000,60). Vertical baseline 50 with no axis-break mark; intervals of 10 thousand.
spec.answerVisibility: Source data only; estimated year and interpolation guides are withheld.

answer.worked: $85\,000$ gorillas corresponds to $85$ on the vertical axis. Read across to the segment between $90$ thousand in 1940 and $80$ thousand in 1960, then down to the year axis. The value is halfway between these readings, so the estimated year is approximately 1950.
